title: Fit the install agents line on every state and make Enter respect the focused button
body:
Close the last design-review blocker on the Remote agent CLI install UI (HEAD ed018ec: src/remote_install.rs, src/remotes_pane.rs). Three small, local changes; nothing else.
Blocked by: Fix review findings on the Remote agent CLI install
1. Blocker. remote_install::agents_line / remotes_pane::agents_line_ui still overflow PANE_MIN_W (about 354 px of line room) on the failure path, and the horizontal layout clips the trailing retry button out of the pane. Estimated widths: "claude installed, needs login + grok install did not finish + codex untried" about 394; "has claude + codex, grok failed" about 370; three failed about 427; "claude installed + codex, grok failed" about 452. agents_fit measures only text, not button rects, so nothing catches it. Make every reachable combination of the three agents' states fit: group failed agents like the other groups ("codex, grok install did not finish"), shorten the copy, and when a failed group sits beside more than one button draw a single "retry" button that opens the confirm (left/right already cycles agents there). Make the fit check count the button rects, and make the layout test enumerate EVERY combination of per-agent states (3 agents x all states) at PANE_MIN_W and assert the whole line, buttons included, is inside the pane rect.
2. Safety. remote_install Prompt::show reads Enter before the buttons. If keyboard focus (Tab) is on "cancel" or "launch anyway", Enter runs the installer instead of the focused button. Make the focused button win: either the three buttons are not focusable, or Enter is ignored by the prompt-level handler while any of them holds focus and activates that button instead. Test it through egui::Context::run with Tab then Enter: no install is confirmed.
3. Order. Buttons come in report order, so a line can read "grok install did not finish - [install codex] - [retry]" with the bare retry detached from its agent. Put a failed agent's button directly after its text, or label it "retry grok" when more than one button is on the line (still within the fit above).
Also: question() can still cut a maximum-length Remote name made of wide glyphs, and the test exempts that case; elide the left-hand text instead so the name always shows, and remove the exemption.
Do NOT run any installer against the test Remote.
Done when: the enumerated fit test and the Tab-then-Enter test pass, and the full suite passes.
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
